---
title: "How to get access to data"
---

The HICD is managed by a steering committee at SDCA consisting of members from both epidemiological and clinical diabetes research. The steering committee strongly encourage interested researchers across disciplines to use this research resource. SDCA will provide applicants with detailed information on the available data and the application procedure. 

To get access to data, please contact: Kasper Norman ([kanoan@rm.dk](mailto:kanoan@rm.dk)) 

All research on HICD-data is based on questionnaires and register data and require no ethical approval of projects. All data analyses are to be performed on SDCA's remote access to [Statistics Denmark's server](https://www.dst.dk/en/TilSalg/Forskningsservice). The application process includes project approval by the steering committee, preparation of dataset, data extraction and access to Statistics Denmark. Normally this process takes four to six months, but will be dependent on the human resources at SDCA.
